headline: Iran Again Targeted Commercial Ships In The Strait Of Hormuz. Now Trump Says The Ceasefire Is Over
summary: Trump said the ceasefire with Iran is over after new U.S. strikes in retaliation for Tehran targeting commercial ships in the Strait of Hormuz. The strait is a key global oil transit route.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of the world's seaborne oil, so disruptions there quickly affect crude prices, shipping costs and risk sentiment.
why_moved: Renewed attacks on commercial ships in the Strait of Hormuz and the end of the ceasefire raise the risk of supply disruption for oil shipments through the waterway.
